name: troubleshooting-guide
title: Troubleshooting guide
description: Problems listed by what the user sees, each opening to the likely cause and numbered fix steps with code or a screenshot, grouped by area.
docs: Problem ids are the anchors support replies link to: a link that targets one opens it, and opening one writes its id to the address bar (syncHash={false} turns that off). The Still stuck? link adds the symptom to supportHref as ?symptom=. Areas are h2 and problems h3, so place it under your page h1.
